name: A sacred shore must be approached

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

summary: At Quel’Danas, Halduron Brightwing first refuses the seeker entry to a sacred place recently reclaimed by the blood elves. The Sunwell is no casual road’s end. Its shores carry the memory of a kingdom nearly lost, and trust must be earned before the blade can reach its light. Beyond the Dead Scar, pale stone and red-gold towers frame a question of stewardship: who may bring this dangerous inheritance to the well?
